title: Public launch: product story, clean source, reproducible proof
scope: Public software release only; no vendor/PLC execution

stages.deliverable: Verified GitHub identity, product name, source baseline, owner license choice
Independent history/privacy/license and claim audit; no edits
Positive English/Turkish README, feature map, working offline demo, MCP setup, contributor entrypoints
Auditable clean source snapshot, synthetic fixtures, machine-free metadata, no inherited private Git history
Offline regressions, isolated all-backend wheel/stdio installation, links and release scanner
Final read-only implementation/test/docs/package review; fix substantive findings before publication
Public GitHub source, topics, release, CI proof, reproducible source archive

claims_policy: Lead with demonstrated strengths. Link precise model/toolchain capability documentation; label roadmap as future. Never advertise a GUI recipe as an implemented MCP compiler.
completion: Published tree matches reviewed source; remote status and release URL recorded
